name: Pietro Branca-d'Oro
bio: A young Italian whom Wilde added to his circle in the spring of 1900, between Palermo and Rome. He survives in one sentence to Robert Ross: 'I have added one Pietro Branca-d'Oro to the group. He is dark, and gloomy, and I love him very much.' Wilde had seven months to live.
bio_note: The volume's General Index entry 'Branca-d'Oro, Pietro (boy), 1181' - the same '(boy)' form the editors use for Georges, André, Alphonse and Armando. This is a different man: Palermo and Rome, April 1900, printed 1181, and Wilde introduces him as a new arrival - 'I have added one Pietro Branca-d'Oro to the group'.
